name: Gachi Yuru Hero Battle Hime Miko Ginga
original_name: ガチゆるヒーローバトル 姫巫女銀河
source: Magical Miko Superheroine that rides mechas and has a (hidden) Bionic Arm fights against foolish and ridiculous villains, losing her clothes in the process. The game features several stages of clothing damage for lovers of this feature.
